subject.title: fix: harden recovered meeting browser sessions

question: Should the recorded fail-closed policy—blocking talk-back until the browser explicitly reports `micMuted: false`—be approved for the current PR head?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility tradeoff for existing sessions with incomplete browser microphone telemetry; tests establish the branch behavior but cannot choose the product policy.

options.title: Approve the strict readiness policy
options.body: Accept temporary talk-back blocking when microphone telemetry is unknown, then land after the current-head gates pass.

options.title: Preserve the prior unknown-state behavior
options.body: Revise the readiness contract if maintaining talk-back availability under omitted microphone telemetry is preferred.

recommendation.title: Approve the strict readiness policy
recommendation.body: Accept temporary talk-back blocking when microphone telemetry is unknown, then land after the current-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged extraction history and this focused follow-up identify steipete as the strongest available owner for the meeting-runtime readiness contract.
